title: Canonical exact-functor transport of shifted degree-zero derived arrows
statement:
Let $B,D$ be abelian categories [def-sp-abelian], with objects in a common universe $c$, morphisms in a common universe $v$, and derived categories with morphisms in a chosen common universe $w$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $F:B\to D$ be additive and preserve finite limits and finite colimits. Let $S,T\in B$, $a\in\mathbf Z$, and $\alpha:S[0]\to T[0][a]$ be a morphism in $D(B)$, where $S[0]$ is the degree-zero single complex. The exact functor induces $D(F):D(B)\to D(D)$ by applying $F$ termwise. Write $s_U:D(F)(U[0])\xrightarrow{\sim}(FU)[0]$ for its canonical single comparison and $\sigma_{a,K}:D(F)(K[a])\xrightarrow{\sim}D(F)(K)[a]$ for its canonical shift comparison. Define the transported derived morphism
$$\operatorname{ExactHom}_F^a(\alpha):(FS)[0]\longrightarrow(FT)[0][a]$$
by the actual composite
$$(FS)[0]\xrightarrow{s_S^{-1}}D(F)(S[0])\xrightarrow{D(F)(\alpha)}D(F)(T[0][a])\xrightarrow{\sigma_{a,T[0]}}D(F)(T[0])[a]\xrightarrow{s_T[a]}(FT)[0][a].$$
This is the existing canonical operation on derived arrows, for every integer $a$; it asserts no functoriality or comparison theorem.

lean.statement:
def functorialCupExactHom {B D : Type c} [Category.{v} B] [Category.{v} D]
    [Abelian B] [Abelian D] [hB : HasDerivedCategory.{w} B]
    [hD : HasDerivedCategory.{w} D] (F : B ⥤ D) [F.Additive]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F]
    {S T : B} (a : ℤ)
    (α : (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor B 0).obj S ⟶
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor B 0).obj T)⟦a⟧) :
    (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor D 0).obj (F.obj S) ⟶
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor D 0).obj (F.obj T))⟦a⟧
